description:
They say location is everything—but at 4216 Ethel Ave, it’s about how you live. Set in the heart of Studio City, this stylish three-level townhouse offers the space of a home with a modern, low-maintenance lifestyle. The main level features an open, light-filled layout with warm laminate floors and a statement brick fireplace—comfortable for everyday living and easy to entertain in. The dining area flows into a granite kitchen with a bright breakfast nook—perfect for morning coffee or casual meals. Upstairs, two spacious bedrooms provide inviting retreats, including a primary suite with a generous walk-in closet. The second bedroom overlooks a peaceful garden, adding a sense of calm and privacy. A true standout is the lower-level bonus room with its own private entrance. Whether you need a home office, creative studio, gym, or guest space, this flexible area adapts to your lifestyle. And the location delivers—just moments from some of Studio City’s favorite dining, shopping, and fitness spots, with convenient access for commuting.
If you’ve been looking for a home that combines comfort, flexibility, and a prime location, this one stands out.
